note: Freshness limits for cited facts (principles 1 and 14). Source of truth: skills/lvr-freshness.json, synced byte-identical to skills/<skill>/references/freshness.json. Limits per spec R2 (owner ruling 2026-11-20); 'general' is an LVR addition. Contract: docs/spec/07-research.md §4; summary in conventions §10.

price.covers: Prices, fees, interest and loan rates, commissions, taxes charged on a purchase, plan costs, exchange rates.

quota.covers: Free-tier limits, usage quotas, rate limits, storage or bandwidth caps, plan allowances.

version.covers: Software, framework, runtime, and API versions; release, support, and end-of-life status.

legal.covers: Terms of service, platform and vendor policies, licences, vendor availability by country or region.

regulation.covers: Laws, government and central-bank regulations, licensing and permit rules, tax law, data-protection law.

market.covers: Competitors, comparable products, market practice, what similar users usually expect.

general.covers: Definitions, how something works, key terms, failure modes and pitfalls.
